title: Castlevania: Rondo of Blood
japaneseTitle: 悪魔城ドラキュラX 血の輪廻
shortDescription: Konami's crowning 16-bit classic Castlevania masterpiece for the PC Engine Super CD-ROM², introducing Richter Belmont, Maria Renard, and CD Redbook audio.
historicalSignificance: The pinnacle of traditional stage-based Castlevania design, introducing Richter Belmont, Item Crash super attacks, anime cutscenes, Redbook CD audio, and serving as the direct narrative prologue to Symphony of the Night.

editorialContent.overview: Directed by Toru Hagihara with scenario planning and early design assistance from Koji Igarashi at Konami, Akumajō Dracula X: Chi no Rondo ('Rondo of Blood') was released exclusively in Japan for the PC Engine Super CD-ROM² in October 1993. Regarded by connoisseurs as the zenith of pre-Metroidvania classic Castlevania action, it leveraged optical disc capacity to deliver an unmatched audiovisual spectacle.
editorialContent.gameplayMechanics: Players control vampire hunter Richter Belmont, armed with the holy Vampire Killer whip and powerful 'Item Crash' magical super attacks. Rescuing the young maiden Maria Renard unlocks her as an alternate playable character, featuring agile double-jumping and magical animal projectiles (doves, dragons, turtles). Stages feature multiple hidden branching pathways leading to alternate boss encounters and stage routes.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Harnessing Hudson and NEC's PC Engine Super CD-ROM² system, Rondo of Blood featured redbook studio CD audio orchestrations, Japanese spoken voice acting, anime cutscenes, and extensive hardware sprite rotation and scaling for towering multi-jointed boss battles like the Wyvern and Hydra.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Though restricted to Japan for over a decade due to the PC Engine's Western decline, Rondo of Blood attained mythical status among retro gaming import enthusiasts. Its gameplay and story directly set the stage for its legendary 1997 PlayStation sequel, Castlevania: Symphony of the Night.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on authentic PC Engine Super CD-ROM² optical ISO/BIN images with cue sheets. Preserving the 16-track Redbook audio soundtrack and System Card 3.0 BIOS timing is essential.
